---
title: "TAOOH — no-treatment sentinel"
subtitle: "Reduced second-order API/data sentinel before primary fits"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This reduced model checks the second-order `mostr::blrm_markov()` call
before the 50 full models. It contains no treatment term and does not calculate
posterior estimands.

The export contains unrestricted follow-up, including the final partial week.
Validate it against the unrestricted survival endpoint before restricting the
sentinel to 26 weeks. The primary survival endpoint can end earlier; an observed
state on the censoring day is not evidence of observation after censoring.

```{r}
#| label: fit-sentinel
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "taooh-helpers.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(rmsb)
library(mostr)

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
taooh_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet"
)
surv_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)

output_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "no-treatment-sentinel.rds"
)
stan_dx_text_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "diagnostics", "stan-dx",
  "no-treatment-sentinel.txt"
)
stan_dx_plot_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "diagnostics", "stan-dx",
  "no-treatment-sentinel.png"
)
dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(dirname(stan_dx_text_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (force || !file.exists(output_path)) {
  data <- arrow::read_parquet(taooh_path) |>
    arrange(id, week)

  surv_data <- arrow::read_parquet(surv_path)
  validate_taooh_follow_up(data, surv_data)
  data <- data |>
    filter(week <= taooh_horizon_weeks(182))

  bad_absorbing <- data |>
    group_by(id) |>
    mutate(death_seen = cumany(replace_na(y_taooh == 5L, FALSE))) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(death_seen, !is.na(y_taooh), y_taooh != 5L) |>
    nrow() > 0L
  if (bad_absorbing) stop("TAOOH death state 5 must be absorbing.")

  data <- data |>
    group_by(id) |>
    mutate(
      y = as.numeric(as.character(y_taooh)),
      yprev = if_else(week - lag(week) == 1L, lag(y_taooh), NA_integer_),
      ypprev = if_else(week - lag(week, 2L) == 2L, lag(y_taooh, 2L), NA_integer_)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(
      week >= 1L,
      !is.na(y), !is.na(yprev), !is.na(ypprev),
      yprev != 5L, ypprev != 5L
    ) |>
    mutate(
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:4, ordered = FALSE),
      ypprev = factor(ypprev, levels = 1:4, ordered = FALSE),
      id = factor(id)
    )

  model_formula <- y ~ rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev + cluster(id)
  fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "taooh")
  fit <- mostr::blrm_markov(
    formula = model_formula,
    data = data,
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    chains = config$markov$chains,
    iter = config$markov$iterations,
    warmup = config$markov$warmup,
    refresh = 1,
    backend = "cmdstan",
    sampling.args = list(
      seed = fit_seed,
      parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
    )
  )
  diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics)

  if (!isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) {
    fit <- mostr::blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed + 500000L,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics)
  }

  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
  saveRDS(list(model = fit, diagnostics = diagnostics), output_path)
}

if (
  force ||
    !file.exists(stan_dx_text_path) ||
    !file.exists(stan_dx_plot_path)
) {
  sentinel <- readRDS(output_path)
  writeLines(capture.output(rmsb::stanDx(sentinel$model)), stan_dx_text_path)
  stan_dx_plot <- rmsb::stanDxplot(sentinel$model)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    stan_dx_plot_path,
    stan_dx_plot,
    width = 11,
    height = max(6, 1.05 * length(unique(stan_dx_plot$data$param))),
    dpi = 180,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}
```
